conclusions: PC improves relative to AI, but BI does not beat B400+I jointly.
Incomplete requested processes and some inherited initial-image/request conflicts dominate many low-SA cases. Do not replace matched test images to manufacture gains.
BI adds real body/structure failures in selected paired cases; full video expert capacity is not validated solely by its higher PC than AI.
Wait for direct_write_only and no_c controls to distinguish learned block effects before CI design; no blind cloning of BT into I2V.
